website_summary.name: Fantasy Football Pick'em Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a vibrant and intuitive interface designed for selecting weekly NFL game picks, complete with personalized rankings and favorite team management.
website_summary.appearance: The website boasts a clean and modern aesthetic with a gradient background transitioning from light blue to white, creating a visually appealing backdrop. The main header displays the title "Fantasy Pick'em" alongside a trophy icon, emphasizing the competitive nature of the platform. Below the header, there's a section titled "Select Your Weekly Picks," which showcases a grid of buttons representing each week's matchups. Each button includes team names, dates, and a plus icon for making selections. On the right side, a "Your Favorites" section allows users to add teams to their favorites list, with a search bar for quick access. Additionally, a "Your Rankings" panel shows current standings with animated progress bars, enhancing the interactive experience.
website_summary.functionality:
The website offers several key functionalities:
- Users can select their weekly picks by clicking on the corresponding buttons for each matchup.
- A search bar within the "Your Favorites" section enables users to quickly find and add teams they support.
- The "Your Rankings" panel provides real-time updates on user performance compared to others, fostering competition.
- Users can navigate through weeks using arrow buttons, allowing them to plan ahead or review past selections.
- The live scoring feature indicates ongoing game updates, keeping users informed in real-time.

functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Favorite Team Buttons correctly marks the team as a favorite.

functionality_testing.expected_results: The button should update to show the team as a favorite.
procedure: Click on a favorite team button.
Verify that the button updates to reflect the team as a favorite.
